GitHub - nilspin/VoxelHashing_demo: A program for GPU based scalable 3D ...
A program for GPU based scalable 3D reconstruction based on Prof. Matthias Niessner's 2013 SIGGRAPH paper VoxelHashing. It has will have 3 components : Image tracking : Point-cloud registration using Point-to-plane Iterative Closest Points algorithm. Uses Gauss-Newton for solving non-linear least squares problem.
